statusRationale: Zero critical findings and no product defect was found: every automated gate is green and every behavioural claim that carries risk is covered. The status is 'failed' solely because three user-spec acceptance criteria (US-05, US-24, US-25) have no automated verification although they are automatable with the tools available here, which per the task's own rule makes them 'failed' rather than 'not_verifiable' — and that in turn fails the aggregate tech-spec criterion TS-9. Labelling the report 'passed' while it carries four failed criteria would misrepresent the outcome to the team lead. Remedy is three small test additions, not code changes.

environment.phase1SkipReason: Skill Phase 1 (Environment Rebuild) requires a Makefile/GNUmakefile or a docker-compose*/compose* file in the repository root. Verified absent: the root holds only esbuild.config.mjs, esbuild.harness.mjs, package.json, playwright.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json and the plugin manifest. This is an Obsidian plugin, not a containerised service — no containers exist, none were invented. Per the skill, the phase is skipped entirely and execution proceeds to Phase 2. The intent of the phase (verify fresh code, not stale artefacts) was honoured by other means, see freshCodeEvidence.

build artefact main.js: present in repository root, 133561 bytes, rebuilt during this run

testSuite.details: All four gates green on Node v22.23.1. Unit 111/111, E2E 99/99, tsc clean, production build clean.

runs.boardLayoutSuiteEvidence: The board-layout suite is not merely green in the total line — vitest printed it by name as an executed file: '✓ tests/unit/boardLayoutUtils.test.ts (8 tests) 5ms'. This was the root cause of Task 1 (the file used to live at src/ui/boardLayoutUtils.test.ts, outside the vitest 'include' glob). Two independent confirmations that the miscollection cannot recur silently: vitest.config.ts include is ['tests/unit/**/*.test.ts'] and the file now sits inside it; and 'ls src/ui/*.test.ts' returns nothing, so no orphan copy remains outside the glob to give a false sense of coverage.

runs.caveat: Per tech-spec Decision 11, tsc silently ignores .svelte files. A clean run is therefore NOT evidence for the popup or the board components; those are gated by the production build and the E2E scenarios instead. This caveat is applied throughout the criteria below — no component criterion cites tsc as its evidence.

runs.note: All five spec files ran in one invocation, workers: 1, fullyParallel: false. No parallel run competed for port 5173.

runs.warnings: 2 pre-existing esbuild-svelte a11y warnings (non-interactive div with click/keydown handlers) in BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:57 and GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:29. Warnings, not errors; the same pattern predates this feature in GroupSettingsPopup. Not a finding.

structuralAudit.note: The task named two places where a green status can be false. Both were audited by reading the scenario code, not by trusting the result.

dragAfterReorderHasNoReload.scenario: tests/e2e/0011-group-customization.spec.ts — 'Сц.5 drag & drop works right after reordering, without a reload' (lines 457-491)
dragAfterReorderHasNoReload.evidence: Between saveBoardSettings() (line 469) and dragCardToGroup() (line 483) the scenario performs only assertions: visibleGroupOrder() and readDomProbes(). There is no page.goto, no resetData, no page.reload — the file's only goto is in beforeEach. The drag uses real mouse input through SortableJS (page.mouse.down/move/up in dragCardToGroup), never the window.__test.moveTask store bypass that helpers.ts exposes; 'moveTask' does not appear in the file at all.
dragAfterReorderHasNoReload.extraStrength: The scenario additionally proves the mechanism, not just the outcome: markDomNodes() stamps a JS expando (__tmProbe, deliberately not an attribute — Svelte rewrites attributes on re-render, so an attribute would survive a node swap and prove nothing) on all wrappers and rendered bodies before the reorder, and after the reorder asserts 6/6 containers and 5/5 bodies still carry it. That is a direct test of tech-spec Decision 1 (no wrapper is recreated, so SortableJS instances survive).
dragAfterReorderHasNoReload.negativeControlOnRecord: Decisions log, Task 10: the false-green variant was actually measured — 'Сц.5 с перезагрузкой между перестановкой и перетаскиванием — тоже зелёный'. The authors built the reload variant, confirmed it stays green on a hypothetically broken product, and shipped the variant without the reload.

orderAssertionsUseComputedStyleNotDomInd.evidence: readGroupBoxes() (lines 47-64) reads Number(getComputedStyle(el).order) and getBoundingClientRect() for every [data-group-container]. visibleGroupOrder() sorts by computed order with domIndex used only as the tie-breaker, which is exactly how a flex/grid container resolves equal order values — not as the ordering signal. Сц.3 backs the computed value with on-screen geometry (delegatedBox.top < orgBox.top) and asserts the notes block by geometry too (notes.top >= max group bottom). No scenario in the file asserts on element index; 'nth(' does not appear.
orderAssertionsUseComputedStyleNotDomInd.whyItMatters: With the CSS-order approach (Decision 1/12) the DOM sequence never changes, so an index-based assertion would pass identically on a working and a broken product.
orderAssertionsUseComputedStyleNotDomInd.counterpartInPopup: settingsRowOrder() deliberately does read DOM sequence — correct there, because popup rows are rendered by an {#each} over the configured order, so in the popup the DOM sequence IS the order.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: В настройках доски у каждой из шести групп есть текстовое поле названия и стрелки перемещения.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.12 asserts expect(page.locator('[data-settings-group]')).toHaveCount(6) with the popup open. src/ui/BoardSettingsPopup.svelte renders input.tm-popup__group-title-input plus two button.tm-popup__group-move-btn inside a single {#each presentGroups} block (lines 80-120), so the controls are structurally per-row. Сц.2/3/4/7/8/9/11/15 drive the input and the arrows on five distinct groups (focus, backlog, delegated, inProgress, orgIntentions). Aggregate evidence: no single assertion counts six inputs and twelve arrows.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Введённое название отображается в заголовке группы на доске после сохранения и переживает перезапуск Obsidian.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.1 'renamed group shows everywhere and survives a reload': renames focus and backlog, saves, asserts both headers, then reads the persisted snapshot (readSavedSnapshot polls until localStorage equals the live store, so it cannot read a pre-edit snapshot) and feeds it back through resetData -> migrateData, re-asserting both titles. Honest nature of the evidence: a real Obsidian restart is not reproducible here; this is the harness analogue the task file designates as acceptable — persisted data round-tripped through the same migration path the plugin uses on load.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Очистка поля возвращает дефолтное название; в пустом поле дефолтное название показано подсказкой ввода.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.2 'title field holds the raw stored value; clearing it restores the default'. Step 1 asserts toHaveValue('') and toHaveAttribute('placeholder', en['group.delegated']) on a never-renamed group; step 3 clears a stored title, saves, asserts the board header returns to en['group.delegated'] and the reopened field is empty with the default back as placeholder. Unit backing: tests/unit/dataStore.test.ts 'clears a previously stored title when an empty name is saved'; tests/unit/groupTitle.test.ts 'empty stored title → default label'.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Ввод ограничен 40 символами; пробелы по краям обрезаются; строка из пробелов равна пустой.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Store boundary (the authoritative point per Decision 7): tests/unit/dataStore.test.ts 'caps a group title at 40 characters, keeping the first 40', 'trims surrounding whitespace from group titles', 'stores a whitespace-only title as empty'. Load boundary: tests/unit/migration.test.ts 'title longer than 40 characters → capped at 40', 'title is trimmed', 'title whitespace-only → empty string', 'the cap never leaves a lone surrogate behind', 'title of exactly 40 characters → unchanged'. Input cap in the browser: maxlength={GROUP_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH} with the constant = 40 at src/ui/BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:16,114. Gap noted, not blocking: no browser assertion tries to enter 41+ characters and check the field truncates — the same rule is enforced twice below the field and is unit-tested at both levels.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Одинаковые названия у разных групп допускаются без предупреждения.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: No test exists — neither unit nor E2E. Searched: no test in tests/unit or tests/e2e assigns the same title to two groups. The nearest unit test, tests/unit/dataStore.test.ts 'writes each name onto its own group', deliberately uses two DIFFERENT titles ('Фокус', 'Кому-то'), so it does not touch this criterion. Reading the code shows the behaviour is implemented by absence (no uniqueness check exists anywhere in BoardSettingsPopup.svelte, dataStore.updateBoard or migration.ts, and no warning element is rendered), but per the task's rule an automatable criterion with no check is a failure, not 'not_verifiable'. See finding F1.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Стрелки меняют порядок групп на доске. Стрелка неактивна в двух случаях: у видимой группы — когда в её направлении не осталось видимых групп, у скрытой — когда она уже крайняя в списке.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Reordering on the board: E2E Сц.3 'arrows reorder groups on the board' — one arrow press on delegated, then the whole visible sequence asserted through computed CSS order plus geometry. Disabled state, both row types: tests/unit/groupOrderUtils.test.ts describe 'canMoveGroup — arrow enabled state' — 'up is disabled for a visible group with no visible group above it', 'down is disabled for a visible group with no visible group below it', 'up is disabled for a hidden group at the first position', 'down is disabled for a hidden group at the last position', 'the only visible group has both arrows disabled', 'empty order and single-element order report both arrows disabled'. Consistency between the two functions is pinned by 'the predicate is true exactly when the move changes the order' and 'move returns the order unchanged whenever the arrow is disabled'. Wiring: disabled={!canMoveGroup(presentGroups, groupId, dir, hiddenGroups)} at BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:95 and :105. The disabled attribute itself is not asserted in a browser scenario — declined on record in the decisions log, Task 10 ('предложения расширить набор на disabled-стрелки ... покрыты unit-тестами задач 03 и 04').

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Стрелка у видимой группы перепрыгивает скрытые: обмен происходит с ближайшей видимой соседкой, и порядок на доске меняется с первого нажатия.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.4 'a visible group jumps over a hidden one on the first click': hides inProgress (which sits between focus and orgIntentions), then presses the down arrow on focus exactly once and asserts the full visible sequence became ['backlog','orgIntentions','focus','delegated','completed'] — i.e. the swap landed on the nearest VISIBLE neighbour, not on the hidden one, and it happened on the first press. Unit backing: tests/unit/groupOrderUtils.test.ts 'visible group steps over several consecutive hidden groups' and its downwards twin.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Стрелка у скрытой группы меняет её местами с соседом по списку; после возврата в видимые группа появляется на доске на заданной позиции.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.15 'a hidden row moves by its literal neighbours and returns to the chosen position'. Its construction matters and was checked: it hides TWO ADJACENT groups (inProgress, orgIntentions) precisely so the first arrow press lands on a hidden neighbour — with only one hidden row both arrow branches produce the same list and the scenario would stay green with the hidden-row branch deleted (recorded in the decisions log, Task 10, as a trap caught in review). Second half of the criterion — the group is then made visible in the same session and the board order is asserted, proving it appears where it was put rather than in its default slot or at the end. Unit backing: describe 'moveGroup — hidden row', 4 tests including 'hidden group swaps with its immediate neighbour regardless of that neighbour's visibility'.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Пустая переименованная группа показывает нейтральную подсказку; пустая группа с дефолтным названием — прежнюю.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.13 'empty-group hint depends on whether the group was renamed': renames focus, asserts its empty state shows en['emptyState.renamed'] while the untouched control group delegated still shows en['emptyState.delegated']; then clears the title and asserts focus returns to en['emptyState.focus']. Both directions covered, and the hint locator is scoped to the group's own container so it cannot match another group's empty state. Implementation: src/ui/EmptyState.svelte derives the key from the stored title alone, using the same emptiness test as resolveGroupTitle.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Новое название отображается везде, где показывается название группы: заголовок группы на доске, заголовок свёрнутой группы, заголовок попапа настроек этой группы, строка в настройках доски.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.1 covers three of the four sites in one scenario: the plain header (.tm-group-header__title of focus), the collapsible header (.tm-collapsible-group__title of backlog, which is collapsed by default — so the title is read in the collapsed state), and the group's own settings popup (.tm-popup__title contains 'Sprint focus'). The fourth site, the board-settings row, is covered by Сц.2 (the input holds the stored value 'Handed over'). Implementation is a single shared helper at all three display sites: resolveGroupTitle in GroupHeader.svelte:15, CollapsibleGroup.svelte:32, GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:11, unit-tested in tests/unit/groupTitle.test.ts (5 tests).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: После изменения порядка группы половинной ширины пакуются парами по новому порядку, а оставшаяся без пары растягивается на всю ширину.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/unit/boardLayoutUtils.test.ts — the suite that was previously not collected at all — covers the packing rule against arbitrary orders: 'произвольный порядок — соседние half образуют пару', 'перестановка разрывает пару — оба half становятся alone', 'произвольный порядок — одинокий half в конце', plus 'все 6 групп fullWidth:false → 3 пары --half' and '[full, half, full, half] → оба half становятся --half-alone'. Wiring: src/ui/BoardLayout.svelte derives BOTH the classes (line 42, computeGroupClasses(orderedGroups)) and the CSS order values (line 48) from the same orderedGroups array, and E2E Сц.3 proves that array reaches the DOM as visual order. See finding F4 (minor): no E2E repacks half-width groups after a reorder — the packing rule is exercised end-to-end only against visibility changes (0007 suite).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Скрытые группы остаются в списке настроек независимо от видимости и визуально отличаются от видимых — их строка выделена пониженной насыщенностью, отличие заметно с первого взгляда в светлой и тёмной темах.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: First half is verified: E2E Сц.15 asserts both hidden rows are still present in the popup and carry the modifier class (toHaveClass(/tm-popup__group-row--hidden/)), and Сц.6 asserts a hidden row keeps its own position in the list. Mechanism for the second half exists: src/styles.css:746 '.tm-popup__group-row--hidden { opacity: 0.5 }' — opacity dims against whatever background the theme supplies, so it is theme-independent by construction. What cannot be verified here is not the presence of the rule but the human judgement it makes a claim about: 'отличие заметно с первого взгляда в светлой и тёмной темах' requires a person looking at the rendered popup in both Obsidian themes. The environment has no live Obsidian and no way to judge perceptibility. Deferred to the user.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Попап настроек не выходит за пределы экрана: при нехватке высоты его содержимое прокручивается.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.12 'popup with a full row list stays on screen and its body scrolls': viewport forced to 1280x400, all six rows present, then the popup's bounding box is asserted inside the viewport (y >= 0 and y+height <= viewport.height+1), and the scrollable element is located by fact (the first descendant whose scrollHeight exceeds clientHeight) and actually scrolled, asserting endTop > startTop. The scenario deliberately does not restate the selection predicate as its assertion — that would be unfalsifiable — which was a review fix recorded in the decisions log, Task 10.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Названия и порядок независимы для каждой доски.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.9 'two boards keep independent titles and order': board A gets a title and an order, board B is created and asserted to start from the defaults (nothing leaked from A), B gets its own different title and order, then A is re-selected and asserted unchanged. Finally a snapshot round-trip re-checks both boards, selecting each explicitly rather than assuming which is active. Both fields (title and order) are checked on both boards in both directions.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: «Отмена» и клик мимо попапа откатывают несохранённые названия и порядок.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Two separate scenarios, one per dismissal route: E2E Сц.7 'Cancel discards an unsaved title and an unsaved order' and Сц.8 'clicking outside the popup discards the same'. Each edits a title AND presses an arrow, dismisses, then asserts three things — the board header shows the default name again, the visible board order equals DEFAULT_ORDER, and the reopened popup shows an empty input and the default row order. Negative control on record (decisions log, Task 10): both scenarios were re-run with Save substituted for the dismissal and went red.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: После обновления плагина существующая доска выглядит идентично прежней, задачи на местах.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/unit/migration.test.ts: 'v7 → v8: every group gets an empty title' (empty title means the localized default is used, i.e. appearance unchanged), 'v7 → v8: every board gets the default group order' (default order means the previous fixed order), 'v7 → v8: tasks are untouched', 'v8 → v8: data unchanged (idempotent)', plus the whole v1..v6 → v8 chain landing on version 8 with the new fields present. Browser-level backing that legacy data actually renders: E2E 0006 Сц.17 (v3 data without hiddenGroups) and 0007 Сц.16 (v4 data without fullWidth) boot the harness from legacy shapes and assert the board renders. Honest nature of the evidence: no live Obsidian upgrade was performed — this is the migration path the plugin runs on load, exercised directly.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Повреждённый порядок групп — посторонний, пропущенный или повторяющийся идентификатор — не мешает доске открыться.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/unit/migration.test.ts describe 'sanitizeGroupOrder' covers every damage shape the criterion names and several it does not: 'groupOrder with an unknown id → unknown id dropped', 'groupOrder with a duplicate id → duplicate collapsed', 'groupOrder missing ids → missing ids appended in default order', plus missing field, null, non-array, empty array, 'already valid and non-default → preserved as is', 'is sanitized on already-migrated v8 data' (proves it runs outside the version branch, per Decision 6), 'damaged fields on the second board are repaired too', 'a board missing a group does not throw (the missing group is not recreated)', and independent-array tests that stop two boards from sharing one order instance. Render-side guards for the residual case (an id survives sanitation but its group object was hand-deleted): src/ui/BoardLayout.svelte:36 filters orderedGroups on existence, src/ui/BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:41 filters presentGroups checking the VALUE not just the key, and tests/unit/dataStore.test.ts 'does not throw on a null group value' and 'survives a board whose group object was removed by hand'. No E2E boots the harness from a hand-damaged snapshot; the unit coverage of the sanitizer plus the render guards carries the criterion.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Секция заметок остаётся под всеми группами независимо от порядка.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.3, final block — executed AFTER a reorder, so it tests the criterion's 'независимо от порядка' clause rather than the default layout. Two independent assertions: the notes container's computed order is strictly greater than the maximum group order (the mechanism from Decision 2 — elements without an explicit order default to 0 and would float above the groups), and its on-screen top is at or below the bottom-most group (the observable result).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Перетаскивание задач работает сразу после изменения порядка, без перезапуска Obsidian и без переоткрытия доски: задача переносится в обе стороны как между обычными группами, так и с участием сворачиваемых («Бэклог», «Выполнено»).
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.5 'drag & drop works right after reordering, without a reload'. Construction audited line by line, not just its status — see structuralAudit.dragAfterReorderHasNoReload: no goto/resetData/reload sits between saveBoardSettings (line 469) and the first drag (line 483); the drag is real mouse input through SortableJS, not the window.__test.moveTask store bypass. Both directions are covered with a collapsible group: focus -> backlog and backlog -> focus, backlog being one of the two collapsible groups the criterion singles out, with card counts asserted in both groups after each drag. The scenario additionally asserts the mechanism directly: JS-expando probes show 6/6 wrappers and 5/5 rendered bodies survive the reorder, so no SortableJS instance could have been destroyed for ANY group. See finding F5 (minor): the ordinary-to-ordinary pair is not dragged after a reorder; that extension was proposed in review and declined on record in the decisions log, Task 10.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: npm test запускается и проходит целиком; тесты раскладки доски выполняются, а не игнорируются.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: npm test -> exit 0, 7 files / 111 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. The board-layout suite is confirmed EXECUTED, not merely implied by a green total: vitest listed it by name, '✓ tests/unit/boardLayoutUtils.test.ts (8 tests) 5ms'. Two further checks that the original miscollection cannot silently return: vitest.config.ts include is ['tests/unit/**/*.test.ts'] and the file lives inside that glob; 'ls src/ui/*.test.ts' finds nothing, so no orphan copy remains at the old location.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Автотесты соседних фич (видимость групп, динамическая ширина, колонки карточек) проходят после того, как названия групп стали изменяемыми.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: In the single full run: tests/e2e/0006-group-visibility.spec.ts 17 passed, tests/e2e/0007-dynamic-layout.spec.ts 16 passed, tests/e2e/0008-card-columns.spec.ts 16 passed, plus tests/e2e/core.spec.ts 35 passed. 99 total, 0 failed. These suites were migrated onto the stable attributes in Task 9 (data-group-container for board wrappers, data-settings-group for popup rows), which is what makes them independent of the now-editable names; the four document.querySelector calls in 0008 that read the group BODY were deliberately left on data-group-id, per Decision 3, to avoid the silent false-pass the shared-attribute alternative would cause.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: В проекте зафиксирована требуемая версия Node — не ниже 22.12, — и установленная версия ей соответствует; на ней проходят тесты и собирается плагин.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Pinned in two places: package.json 'engines': { 'node': '^22.12.0 || >=24.0.0' } and .nvmrc containing 22.23.1. Installed: node -v -> v22.23.1, which satisfies the range and matches .nvmrc exactly. The recorded range is stricter than the criterion's prose and deliberately so (Decision 8): a bare '>=22.12' would admit the 23.x line that vitest declares unsupported. On this runtime all four gates passed in this session: npm test (111), npx tsc --noEmit (clean), npx playwright test (99), npm run build (both artefacts produced).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Строки в списке настроек идут в едином порядке групп: скрытые занимают свои позиции наравне с видимыми и не сдвигаются в конец, порядок сохраняется при повторном открытии попапа.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.6 'reopening the popup keeps the row order, hidden rows included': hides inProgress and moves delegated up in one session, saves, reopens the popup and asserts the row sequence is ['backlog','focus','inProgress','delegated','orgIntentions','completed'] — the hidden inProgress sitting in its own third position rather than at the end. The scenario also asserts the board's visible order in between, which is the guard that makes the row assertion meaningful: without it the expected sequence would be byte-identical to what an unhidden board produces and a lost hidden row would go unnoticed (comment at lines 439-440). Сц.7/Сц.8 additionally assert the row order after a cancelled edit.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Переключение видимости немедленно меняет вид строки, не дожидаясь сохранения.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: No test asserts the row's appearance BEFORE saving. The only assertions on the dimming class in the whole test tree are tests/e2e/0011-group-customization.spec.ts:407-408, and they run after saveBoardSettings() and a popup reopen — i.e. they verify the SAVED state, which is a different claim. Сц.11 does exercise the unsaved local state, but through arrow behaviour (criterion US-27), not through the row's look. The behaviour is implemented — src/ui/BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:85 binds class:tm-popup__group-row--hidden to the local hiddenGroups array that the checkbox mutates, so no save is involved — but the criterion is trivially automatable (one toHaveClass assertion immediately after the toggle click) and has no check. See finding F2.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Название из 40 символов не ломает вёрстку: в попапе оно прокручивается внутри поля, в заголовке группы на доске усекается многоточием.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Second half verified, first half unverified. Board header (verified): E2E Сц.10 'a 40-character title does not break the header line' — viewport narrowed to 700px so 40 characters cannot fit, then asserts the title's height did not grow (no wrap onto a second line), scrollWidth > clientWidth (truncated rather than shown in full), and the header row's own overflow stays within its client width. The right-edge check was replaced during review by the header-overflow check because the original was structurally unfalsifiable — recorded in the decisions log, Task 10. Popup field (NOT verified): no test asserts anything about the input's overflow behaviour. The CSS exists (src/styles.css:769-781, flex:1 with min-width:0 and text-overflow:ellipsis; the grid column is minmax(0,1fr)), and the same assertion style already used for the header (scrollWidth vs clientWidth on the input, row height unchanged) would close it. See finding F3.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Каждая группа на доске адресуема по служебному признаку независимо от её названия и от того, свёрнута она или развёрнута.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: data-group-container is set on all six wrappers in src/ui/BoardLayout.svelte (lines 209, 225, 240, 255, 270, 285) — on the WRAPPER, which exists in both collapsed and expanded states, unlike data-group-id which lives in the body and disappears when a group is collapsed. Independence from the name and from the collapsed state is exercised, not just asserted structurally: E2E Сц.1 reads the title of a RENAMED and COLLAPSED backlog through [data-group-container='backlog']; helpers.expandGroup reaches the collapsed header through the same attribute; readGroupBoxes enumerates all six wrappers by it. The attribute is deliberately distinct from data-group-id and from data-settings-group (Decision 3) — the whole 84-scenario pre-existing corpus was migrated onto it in Task 9 and is green.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Стрелки исходят из несохранённого состояния видимости: переключение видимости в попапе немедленно меняет их поведение, не дожидаясь сохранения.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.11 'toggling visibility changes arrow behaviour before saving': hides inProgress and, WITHOUT saving, presses the down arrow on focus once. The resulting row order shows focus stepped OVER the just-hidden inProgress — the visible-row branch acting on unsaved state; had the arrows read the saved state, focus would have swapped with inProgress instead. The assertion is made in the popup, since the board still shows the saved state at that moment; the save that follows confirms the result reaches the board. Negative control on record (decisions log, Task 10): the scenario without the visibility toggle before the arrow goes red.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: npm test -> exit 0, 111/111 passed across 7 files. The formerly uncollected suite is listed by name in the run output: '✓ tests/unit/boardLayoutUtils.test.ts (8 tests)'. vitest.config.ts include ['tests/unit/**/*.test.ts'] now contains the file's location, and no orphan copy remains under src/ui/.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: npx tsc --noEmit -> exit code 0, output 0 bytes. This includes the pre-existing 'boardSettings.notes' key that Decision 9 required adding to the TranslationKey union — present at src/i18n/types.ts:27. Interpretation caveat applied throughout this report (Decision 11): tsc does not check .svelte files, so this result is not cited as evidence for any component-level criterion. It does, however, guarantee locale parity: src/i18n/types.ts:46 declares Translations = Record<TranslationKey, string> and both en.ts and ru.ts are annotated with it, so a key missing from either locale would be a type error.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: npm run build -> exit code 0. Both artefacts were deleted beforehand and reappeared: main.js (133561 bytes) and styles.css (21016 bytes) in the repository root, which is where Obsidian loads them from. Two esbuild-svelte a11y WARNINGS (non-interactive div with click/keydown handlers, BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:57 and GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:29) — warnings only, the pattern predates this feature in GroupSettingsPopup.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: `npx playwright test` passes, including all pre-existing suites
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: npx playwright test -> exit code 0, 99 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped in 31.0s, one invocation covering all five spec files: 0006-group-visibility (17), 0007-dynamic-layout (16), 0008-card-columns (16), 0011-group-customization (15), core (35). The run used a freshly started harness — port 5173 was verified free beforehand, so reuseExistingServer could not attach to a stale server, and the harness build output appears in the run log.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Data version is 8; migrated boards render identically to before the upgrade
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Version: tests/unit/migration.test.ts 'null → default data (version=8)', '{} → default data (version=8)', 'v1 → v8: all fields are migrated in one pass', and the v2..v7 → v8 chain; 'v8 → v8: data unchanged (idempotent)'. Identical rendering: 'v7 → v8: every group gets an empty title' (empty means the localized default, so names are unchanged) and 'v7 → v8: every board gets the default group order' (which is the previously hardcoded order), with 'v7 → v8: tasks are untouched' covering the data itself. Browser-level backing on legacy shapes: 0006 Сц.17 and 0007 Сц.16.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A hand-damaged order field of any shape still yields a working board
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 'Any shape' is covered literally by tests/unit/migration.test.ts describe 'sanitizeGroupOrder': missing field, null, non-array value, empty array, unknown id, duplicate id, missing ids, already-valid non-default order, damage on a second board, and damage on already-migrated v8 data (which proves the sanitizer runs outside the version branch, Decision 6). Title sanitation has the same shape-tolerance: describe 'sanitizeGroupTitle' includes 'title not a string → empty string'. The residual case a sanitizer cannot fix — an id survives but its group object was hand-deleted — is guarded at render (BoardLayout.svelte:36, BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:41 checking the value rather than the key) and covered by tests/unit/dataStore.test.ts 'does not throw on a null group value' and 'survives a board whose group object was removed by hand', plus migration 'a board missing a group does not throw'.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No DOM wrapper is recreated when order changes — drag & drop works without reload
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Both halves are asserted inside E2E Сц.5, and its construction was audited (structuralAudit.dragAfterReorderHasNoReload). Wrapper survival is measured directly: markDomNodes() stamps a JS expando __tmProbe (deliberately not an attribute — Svelte rewrites attributes on re-render, so an attribute would survive a node swap and prove nothing) on every wrapper and every rendered body before the reorder; readDomProbes() then asserts containersTotal=6 with all 6 still marked and bodiesTotal=5 with all 5 still marked (completed stays collapsed, so it has no body). Drag without reload: the scenario contains no goto/resetData/reload between the save and the drags, and moves a card focus -> backlog -> focus through real mouse input.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A 40-character group name truncates in the header instead of breaking its layout
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: E2E Сц.10, on a 700px viewport where 40 characters cannot fit a half-width column: title height unchanged within 1px (no wrap), scrollWidth > clientWidth (content truncated rather than shown), and headerScrollWidth <= headerClientWidth+1 (the title absorbed the length instead of pushing the header row past the group). CSS backing: src/styles.css:138-146 (.tm-group-header__title with overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap, min-width:0) and :229-235 for the collapsible header. Negative controls on record (decisions log, Task 10): the scenario re-run with a 5-character title went red, and a stand rebuilt with white-space:nowrap replaced by overflow-wrap:anywhere went red. Note this tech-spec criterion covers only the header — the popup-field half of the corresponding user-spec criterion US-25 is unverified.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Every acceptance criterion from the user-spec is satisfied
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Aggregate criterion, and it inherits the state of its parts: 23 of the 27 user-spec criteria are passed, 1 is not_verifiable by environment (US-12, theme readability), and 3 are failed for absence of any verification — US-05 (duplicate titles allowed), US-24 (row dims immediately, before saving), US-25 (40-character title scrolls inside the popup field). No user-spec criterion was found to be violated by the product; all three failures are missing checks on implemented behaviour. See findings F1, F2, F3.

findings.title: No check that two groups may carry the same name (US-05)
findings.expected: An automated check that setting the same title on two groups saves cleanly, both headers show it, and no warning is rendered.
findings.actual: No such test exists in tests/unit or tests/e2e. tests/unit/dataStore.test.ts 'writes each name onto its own group' uses two different titles and does not touch the criterion. This is a verification gap, not a defect: no uniqueness check and no warning element exist anywhere in BoardSettingsPopup.svelte, dataStore.updateBoard or migration.ts, so the behaviour holds by construction.
findings.reproduction: grep -rniE 'duplicate|same (name|title)' tests/ returns only groupOrder duplicate-id tests. Reading BoardSettingsPopup.svelte and dataStore.updateBoard shows no name-uniqueness logic.
findings.suggestedFix: In tests/e2e/0011-group-customization.spec.ts: set the same title on focus and delegated, save, assert both group headers show it and that the popup renders no warning element.

findings.title: No check that a row dims immediately on toggling visibility, before saving (US-24)
findings.expected: An assertion that the row acquires tm-popup__group-row--hidden right after the checkbox click, with no save in between.
findings.actual: The only assertions on that class (0011 spec, lines 407-408) run after saveBoardSettings() and a popup reopen, i.e. they verify the saved state. Сц.11 exercises the unsaved local state but through arrow behaviour, which is a different criterion (US-27). Verification gap, not a defect: BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:85 binds the class to the local hiddenGroups array the checkbox mutates, so no save is involved.
findings.reproduction: grep -n 'toHaveClass' tests/e2e/ returns exactly two hits, both after saveBoardSettings() in Сц.15.
findings.suggestedFix: In Сц.11 or Сц.15, immediately after visibilityToggle(page, 'inProgress').click() and before any save, assert toHaveClass(/tm-popup__group-row--hidden/), and assert the class is absent again after toggling back.

findings.title: No check that a 40-character title scrolls inside the popup field (US-25, first half)
findings.expected: An assertion that a 40-character value in the settings input overflows horizontally inside the field (scrollWidth > clientWidth) without growing the row's height.
findings.actual: Only the board-header half of the criterion is tested (Сц.10). Nothing asserts the input's overflow behaviour, and the row-height side is untested too. Verification gap, not a defect: src/styles.css:769-781 gives the input flex:1 with min-width:0 and text-overflow:ellipsis inside a minmax(0,1fr) grid column, which is the intended mechanism.
findings.reproduction: grep -n 'scrollWidth' tests/e2e/ returns only the four hits inside Сц.10, all reading the board header and its title, none reading .tm-popup__group-title-input.
findings.suggestedFix: Extend Сц.10: after typing the 40-character title, with the popup open and a narrow viewport, measure the input's scrollWidth vs clientWidth and the row's height before and after — the same assertion shape already used for the header.

findings.title: Half-width repacking after a reorder is verified only at unit level (US-11)
findings.expected: One E2E that sets two groups to half width, moves them apart or together with the arrows, and asserts the resulting --half / --half-alone classes and row geometry on the real board.
findings.actual: computeGroupClasses is unit-tested against arbitrary orders ('произвольный порядок — соседние half образуют пару', 'перестановка разрывает пару'), and the 0007 suite tests packing end to end — but only against visibility and full-width changes, never after a reorder. The wiring that connects the two (BoardLayout.svelte lines 42 and 48 deriving classes and order from the same orderedGroups array) is verified by reading the code, with Сц.3 proving that array reaches the DOM as visual order.
findings.reproduction: grep -n 'half' tests/e2e/*.spec.ts shows all packing assertions live in 0007, whose scenarios only call setFullWidth and the visibility toggles; grep 'groupOrder' tests/e2e/ returns nothing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scenario: make orgIntentions and delegated half width, move one so they become adjacent, assert both carry --half and share a row (equal top), then separate them and assert --half-alone.

findings.title: Drag after reorder is not exercised between two ordinary groups (US-19)
findings.expected: The criterion names two pairings: between ordinary groups, and involving a collapsible one. Both ways.
findings.actual: Сц.5 covers only focus <-> backlog (ordinary <-> collapsible), in both directions. The ordinary <-> ordinary pairing after a reorder is not dragged. The residual risk is low because the same scenario proves structurally that ALL six wrappers and all five rendered bodies survive the reorder, so no group's SortableJS instance can have been destroyed. The extension was proposed in review and declined on record — decisions log, Task 10: 'перетаскивание между двумя обычными группами (за пределами списка сценариев задачи)'.
findings.reproduction: Read tests/e2e/0011-group-customization.spec.ts lines 483-490: the only two drags are focus -> backlog and backlog -> focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one more pair of drags to Сц.5, e.g. focus -> inProgress and back, reusing dragCardToGroup.

knownLimitationsNotCountedAsFailures: docs/technical.md still describes schema version 7 and a fixed group order. Task 12 (wave 9) updates it and is scheduled after this acceptance; out of scope here by the task file's explicit statement.

Сц.14 cannot perform the literal 'switch the language and watch headers translate' check — the harness pins locale to 'en' (locale.set('en')) and exposes no way to change it. The causal condition is verified instead (all six stored titles are empty, the state in which resolveGroupTitle returns the localized default), with translation itself covered by tests/unit/groupTitle.test.ts. Recorded in the decisions log, Task 10.
Keyboard/screen-reader order follows the DOM and therefore diverges from the configured visual order — a deliberate, documented consequence of Decision 1, accepted in tech-spec Decision 14.

npx tsc --noEmit does not type-check .svelte files (Decision 11). Component correctness is gated by the production build and the E2E scenarios; no criterion in this report cites tsc as evidence for component behaviour.

An observation left unfixed by Task 10 and repeated here for the record, not as a finding against this feature: freshDefaultData() in src/data/migration.ts shallow-spreads DEFAULT_DATA, so a second resetData() call inside one test page can inherit state from the first. Invisible in the plugin (migrateData(null) runs once per load) and harmless to current test isolation (one page per test), but the first scenario that calls resetData twice in one test will hit it.
